name: GPT Astra Oracle
tagline: Plan and review packets for a Cursor cloud agent, from a second model
description: An odd and useful relay: a Grok bot whose output is meant for another tool entirely. It returns tight PLAN or REVIEW blocks sized to paste into a Cursor cloud coding agent, with none of the usual chat padding around them. Handy when a second model's read on a plan is wanted before code gets written.
author: nathanromano
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
